title: Unsure! Did I receive mine missing pieces/instructions?
text:
Unsure! Did I receive mine missing pieces/instructions?. Highly anticipated and awaiting its arrival- this was a mess at best and let down in the end.. I have to believe the item that I received was flawed..?

First off, there were zero instructions included besides a product information sheet and then, what clearly appeared to be missing hardware? We were left uncertain since nothing was marked in any capacity.. so, i’m guessing this may have been a return? If so, unfortunately all items didn’t make it into the box? Not even a photo to accompany the end product in the package. Possibly missed during packing..?

Try as we might to figure it out… We just didn’t have success! Counting the amount of holes drilled- we knew we were short x5 pieces of hardware or screws and x2 wheels!? All this leaves me unable to provide feedback on product sturdiness, ease in building or feedback to inform if it’s structurally sound- sorry for that. I did notice this is painted black vs. being made solid black.. When assembling be careful not to scratch with tools as paint could chip off quite easily.. I’d recommend investing in a spray can of finish topcoat just to secure paint for wear/tear and longevity..!!

I’m giving two stars for the simple reason… This may be a isolated incident in receiving what could be a quality product but I am unable to say for certain. Upon arrival I suggest thoroughly checking to be sure you have instructions and hardware necessary. Hoping this info can help in your decision… Good luck!
